plainLanguage: Section 138B — Sexual exploitation of children. Ufafanuzi huu unafuata vipengele vya statutory text ya R.E. 2022.
meaning: Section 138B must be applied using its exact conduct, intention, consent, age, authority, evidential and penalty requirements.
keyPoints: Read each subsection and paragraph as part of the statutory elements.
Consent, age, intention, knowledge, authority and penalties must be applied only where the provision states them.
Any defence, time limit or compensation provision in the section must be preserved.

history.summary: Section 138B appears in Chapter XV — Offences Against Morality — Penal Code [CAP. 16 R.E. 2022].
notes: Official text verified against the government-hosted R.E. 2022 publication.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: Each express element should be established from admissible evidence without expanding the offence beyond the statutory wording.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: Consent, age thresholds, defences, complaint limits and sentencing provisions require separate attention where the section expressly includes them.

debateQuestion: Je, evidence na procedure zinatimiza masharti yote ya section 138B?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
